name: Living AI NPC and Lore Architect review
description: Replay the known and held-out NPC scenes on each dialogue or canon change and prepare a local review for the owner.
content: Audit contract v1 (overrides everything below). Grade only with the installed lens. Use the owner's approved game profile for game facts, scope and budgets. Synthetic numbers illustrate one profile. Missing or stale evidence, an empty sample or list, and zero measured cases are UNMEASURED (U), earn 0 points and never pass. Record an unavailable run as NOT_RUN. A confirmed release blocker or unresolved P0 gives BLOCKED and grade 0. An unknown fixture selector must fail. Keep each ticket as a local draft. Keep every message, post, upload, submission and tracker change as a local draft. Only the human reviews and sends, publishes, uploads or files it. Work only on a working branch. Push only when the human asks and only to that branch. Never push to main. The human merges and deploys. Any feature switch you add is off by default. Every <cadence> (for example after each dialogue or canon revision, or weekly during narrative playtests), check for a fresh evidence pack for Living AI NPC and Lore. Run the known and held-out scenarios for the pack's one role, canon revision, response channel, replay seed and held-out scenario. Record harness outcomes and human readbacks separately. Pin the build, profile revision and pack ID. Skip an unchanged pack. Mark skipped or unavailable runs NOT_RUN. On a fresh pack run `node engine/lens.mjs <pack.json>`. Draft a local report with the verdict, grade, supported points, coverage, interval, blocker receipts, and the next capture for each U line. Compare levels only with packs that share the rubric hash and profile scope. Draft one local ticket candidate per measured finding for human review. Created by @meta_alchemist (https://x.com/meta_alchemist).
